prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Helpful changes: Preset fast-track adoption flows, moving sign-in right after pet adoption, photo quality assistant callouts, interactive progress carousels, split-view path selection screens, and custom pet style selector views.
No clear effect: Spotlight welcome layouts, background notification prompts, account sync banners, subsequent sign-in reorders/flows, desktop diagnostic flows, starter hubs, carousel path layouts, waiting hints/indicators, visibility prompts, archetype selector flows, and hatching progress bars.
Worse performance: Pre-adoption photo prep screens, path decision speed helper callouts, path choice flexibility reassurance copy, and desktop dock placement guidance banners.
Predictions were too low for photo quality assistant callouts, interactive progress carousels, split-view path selection screens, and custom pet style selector views.
Predictions were too high for preset fast-track adoption flows, sign-in reordering, and all changes that showed no clear effect or performed worse.

Changes:
0: [finish, redesign] Desktop Control Action Video Card: Redesign the final home intro screen with a centered video walkthrough card showcasing desktop interaction shortcuts, hiding, and talking controls. (why: Support received multiple complaints regarding confusion over how to control, hide, or talk to the pet post-onboarding, and the finish step conversion drops to 64.8%.)
1: [adoption, new_flow] Photo Quality Interactive Badge Assistant: Introduce a real-time status badge and helper prompt on the photo upload view to guide custom photo uploads prior to generation. (why: Custom pet generation fails or generates unexpected results for several users, contributing to a high mean drop-off time (1017s) during adoption.)
2: [home, new_screen] Desktop Spawn Verification Screen: Add a dedicated spawn verification step right after waiting that confirms the desktop pet asset has rendered on screen before completing onboarding. (why: Support received multiple high-priority bug reports stating pets fail to appear on the desktop or the app stalls before completion.)
3: [sign_in, reorder] Pre-Finish Sign-In Reorder Flow: Move sign-in step to occur right before the final home intro screen after waiting finishes. (why: Users face high hesitation at sign-in early in the flow (mean 567s). Asking for account creation right before final desktop release maintains early adoption momentum.)
4: [choose_path, copy] Simplified Express Companion Directives: Update choose path text to emphasize instantaneous adoption choices with minimal setup time. (why: The choose_path step has an extremely long mean duration (514s), indicating users deliberate far too long on early path decisions.)
5: [adoption, incentive] Pet Adoption Seal Reward Visual: Add an official adoption seal mascot badge component to the adoption certificate screen to build excitement before final generation. (why: Adoption step conversion is 75.3% with a long mean duration (1017s); reinforcing official ownership encourages users to complete creation.)
6: [sign_in, hint] Pet Persistence Account Sign-In Hint: Add a prominent hint banner on sign-in clarifying that signing into the correct account prevents pet data loss across app launches. (why: Support received 8 reports regarding pets missing or resetting after signing back in, causing user friction and confusion.)
7: [home, notification] Audio Notification Generation Complete Switch: Add a desktop system notification trigger switch on the waiting screen so users can safely minimize the app during long renders. (why: Mean wait time during generation is 2336s; letting users enable background completion alerts prevents app abandonment.)
8: [choose_path, layout] Split View Story Intro Showcase: Change the initial story intro layout to a split view highlighting companion preview animations alongside welcome text. (why: Initial choose_path step drop-off (18%) and long completion times indicate users need immediate visual engagement upon launching onboarding.)

scores.note: Finish step redesigns have previously reduced conversion by 3.1%.
Photo quality assistants strongly improve adoption completion (+9.3%).
Adding extra verification screens creates friction in home step.
Sign-in reorders show mild lift (+2.0%), though earlier expectations were over-optimistic.
Path choice copy helper callouts performed poorly (-2.8%).
Adding reward visuals on adoption certificate provides a modest boost.
Sign-in hints directly address user support complaints with minimal implementation effort.
Notification switches during long waits yield reliable improvement (+3.4%).
Split-view path intro screens are proven high-confidence winners.
